title: Test suites relies on the language set in the editor settings
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in:
    - v4.3.1.rc.custom_build [6699ae789] (branch `4.3`)
    - v4.4.dev.custom_build [61accf060] (master at 61accf060515416da07d913580419fd8c8490f7b)
- Not reproducible in:
    - v4.0.5.rc.custom_build [6c99b77a8] (branch `4.0`)
    - v4.2.3.rc.custom_build [3504c98c1] (branch `4.2`)

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev (61accf060) - Windows 10.0.22631 - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.4660) - AMD Ryzen 7 8845H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

Some test suites contain UI texts that are translated in different display languages.
When using languages other than English in editor settings, those tests will fail:
(Tested in Chinese, Japanese and French, the text in the test changed to reflect current editor settings for display language)
```
===============================================================================
.\tests/core/input/test_input_event_key.h(108):
TEST CASE:  [InputEventKey] Key correctly converts itself to text

.\tests/core/input/test_input_event_key.h(119): ERROR: CHECK( none_key.as_text() == "(Unset)" ) is NOT correct!
  values: CHECK( (未設定) == (Unset) )

.\tests/core/input/test_input_event_key.h(123): ERROR: CHECK( none_key.as_text() == "Ctrl+(Unset)" ) is NOT correct!
  values: CHECK( Ctrl+(未設定) == Ctrl+(Unset) )

.\tests/core/input/test_input_event_key.h(127): ERROR: CHECK( none_key.as_text() == "Ctrl+Enter (Physical)" ) is NOT correct!
  values: CHECK( Ctrl+Enter (物理) == Ctrl+Enter (Physical) )

.\tests/core/input/test_input_event_key.h(135): ERROR: CHECK( none_key2.as_text() == "Enter (Physical)" ) is NOT correct!
  values: CHECK( Enter (物理) == Enter (Physical) )

===============================================================================
.\tests/core/input/test_input_event_key.h(154):
TEST CASE:  [InputEventKey] Key correctly converts its state to a string representation

.\tests/core/input/test_input_event_key.h(157): ERROR: CHECK( none_key.to_string() == "InputEventKey: keycode=(Unset), mods=none, physical=false, location=unspecified, pressed=false, echo=false" ) is NOT correct!
  values: CHECK( InputEventKey: keycode=(未設定), mods=none, physical=false, location=unspecified, pressed=false, echo=false == InputEventKey: keycode=(Unset), mods=none, physical=false, location=unspecified, pressed=false, echo=false )

ERROR: Index p_gutter = 2 is out of bounds (text.size() = 1).
   at: TextEdit::Text::remove_gutter (scene\gui\text_edit.cpp:452)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Build the engine with `tests=yes`.
2. Change the language in editor settings to one that is not English.
3. Run tests `--test`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
